decisions.quote:
Our results suggest that the dorsal stream processes elongated shapes but does not process the tool category specifically.
Although
Almeida et al. (2008)
noted that dorsal stream computations influence object recognition processes for objects that can be manipulated, our results suggest that dorsal stream activation during priming may be due to shape attributes.
decisions.reason: The authors directly replicate the original priming effect using the method and stimuli of Almeida et al. (2008) (Results, lines 263-272; Discussion, lines 339-343), but the central message of the paper across five experiments is that the original tool stimuli were confounded with elongated shape and therefore do not validly demonstrate category-specific tool processing in the dorsal stream. Under the codebook definition of 'statistically successful but flawed' (authors obtain the original effect using the original method/materials but argue as their main message that it is not a valid test of the claimed hypothesis), the blind coder's outcome is correct rather than 'mixed'.
